_README: Human knowledge that cannot be derived from source: WHY each flag is or is not
used, and when it SHOULD be used. Flag names and defaults are NOT stored here --
they are parsed from scratch/mptd_pqs_sdvn/ by tools/dump_run_config.py so they
cannot drift. Add an entry for every new flag; the generator reports gaps.

canonical_run._verified: Read back from /proc/<pid>/cmdline of the completed 300 s run on 2026-08-07 (PIDs 2262814/816/818). This is the exact configuration behind D1 0.763 / D4 0.758 / D6 0.766.
canonical_run.preflight:
# 1. deployed model must be the ORIGINAL (the Fix-A model is a known dead end)
cd $NS3/analytics/ml/models/urban_combined
readlink gat_model.onnx     # EXPECT: ../urban/gat_model.onnx
cat theta_s.txt             # EXPECT: 19.74
cat theta_ae.txt            # EXPECT: 33.693885

# 2. binary is current
cd $NS3 && ./waf build --targets=mptd_pqs_sdvn

# 3. after launching, confirm the flags that ACTUALLY reached the process
for p in <pids>; do tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$p/cmdline; echo; done

traps.detail: Declared in `07_socket_layer.h:16`, not in any config header -- which is why it stayed invisible. Always pass `--routing_test=false`.
Mode 1 = AB1, not full mode. Always pass `--ablation_mode=0`.
The OR-path is ON unless you explicitly pass `--gat_det_flag_heads=0`. Reported runs pass 0.
Need `=0`/`=1`, not bare flags. A bare `--ring_detect` does not enable it.
Must be `build/lib` or the ONNX sessions fail to load.
`full_anom=YES` / `full_anom=no` -- case differs between the two outcomes.
The pattern matches your own shell. Use explicit PIDs.

Keying on `(rsu,t,vid)` silently dedups and has twice produced results contradicting the simulator. Add an occurrence index and validate the parsed confusion matrix against the simulator's printed `MCC_full` before trusting any analysis.

traps.trap: theta_S must come from **in-sim** clean p95
traps.detail: Never the offline corpus. Offline 3.709 vs in-sim 41.46; using the offline value collapsed MCC to 0.20.
Writing to it does nothing. Fusion reads `psi`, so flags must be set BEFORE psi is computed (~`08_detection_engine.h:2288`), not after.
Isolates each run's `analytics/results_pid<PID>/`. Without it, per-beacon logs collide -- `a4_p40_m0` was once found to contain all of `a3_p40_m0`.
Declared `02_config_globals.h:221`. Never passed on any reported run, so TP-S3/MP-S4 were in STEALTH mode throughout. Not a bug, but it is an unstated experimental condition.

mobility_source.why: Drive mobility from the SUMO trace rather than an ns-3 mobility model.

maxspeed.why: Urban regime speed. Distinct from `--s_max_kmh`, which is the DETECTOR bound.

N_Vehicles.why: Fleet size for the reported scenario; matches `tab:set-network`.

attack_number.why: 0 = COMBINED mode, all seven variants active at once. Any other value runs a single variant.

attack_percentage.why: rho_a = 0.40, the default high-stress point. Measured beacon-level poisoning at this setting is 79.16%, not the 89.6% quoted in paper item P3.

simTime.why: Full duration. NOTE: ordering D1<D4<D6 holds at a 90 s cutoff but NOT over the full 300 s -- see the audit.

ablation_mode.why: Full scoring. Ablation is done by zeroing COMPONENTS (`--enable_gat/--enable_lstm_ae`), never by switching the simulator to a lightweight mode. This is the distinction between a valid ablation and a broken pipeline.

routing_test.why: Must be forced off; the default is true and silently invalidates results.

skip_blockchain.why: Detection runs do not need the Fabric round-trip. Turn OFF for the RQ5/RQ6 crypto-latency runs.

per_pid_results.why: Isolates each concurrent arm's results directory. Essential when D1/D4/D6 run in parallel.

enable_gat.why: Selects the arm. GAT off => S_i = 0, k_hat = -1, OR-flag off, and lambda_gat is dropped from the fusion sum and the survivors renormalised.

enable_lstm_ae.why: Selects the arm. AE off => eps_i = 0 and lambda_ae dropped + renormalised, identically to the GAT path.

seed.why: Unified ns-3 RngRun + attack randomness. Vary for mean+/-std across seeds.

per_rsu_vehicle_state.why: Fix B. Binds every vehicle_state access to the receiving RSU so an impersonator cannot contaminate the victim's kinematic history at a different RSU. Measured: vid98 FPR 1.0000 -> 0.0691, MCC +0.032.

ring_detect.why: Deterministic Sybil-ring geometry test. Ghost recall 0.49 -> 0.99 at zero FP cost, MCC +0.19. Fires through the MP-S1 signature bit, so it lifts ALL arms equally -- which is why it compresses the ablation ordering.

gat_det_flag_heads.why: DISABLES the GAT head OR-path entirely. Default is 46 (on). Beacons flagged only via this path were 54-55% of D4/D6 false positives for 285/306 true positives -- a poor exchange. Note this means paper item G4's Phi floor had nothing to act on.

psi_cond_floor.why: Floors attack-conditioned psi at the global-weight psi: psi_fuse = max(s, s_global). Prevents k_hat misrouting from ERASING rule evidence. Measured effect: D4's true-positive losses vs D1 went from 158 to ZERO. D1 is provably unaffected (k_hat < 0 there, so the floor is a no-op).

ghost_batch.why: Built and never used in any reported run. Batches a ghost ring into ONE GAT window (N=4-5) instead of the standard window.
ghost_batch.when: Required if paper item S3 is to be published as written -- S3 currently describes behaviour that was OFF. Enable and re-run, or reword S3.

ghost_ae.why: Extends LSTM-AE temporal scoring to ghost identities. Deliberately off: ghosts have no genuine kinematic history to reconstruct against.
ghost_ae.when: Only if ghost temporal modelling is added as a contribution.

gat_or_path_min_phi.why: Phi floor before the GAT head OR-path may force a detection. Left at 0.0 because the OR-path itself is disabled via `--gat_det_flag_heads=0`, so there is nothing to floor.
gat_or_path_min_phi.when: Only meaningful together with `--gat_det_flag_heads=46`. Paper item G4 proposes 0.60; that pairing has NOT been run.

cder_credit_cp_detect.why: Credits CP-DETECT's flag_c to CDER so a caught controller compromise stops counting as UNDETECTED control error. Off by default to keep legacy CDER reproducible.
cder_credit_cp_detect.when: Required if paper item C1 is to be published -- C1 describes behaviour that was OFF in every reported run.

lifecycle_gates_fusion.why: AB8 option B: discounts a demoted RSU's psi in fusion. Without it the RSU lifecycle cannot influence MCC/CDER at all (toggling `enable_rsu_lifecycle` alone left both metrics bit-identical).
lifecycle_gates_fusion.when: AB8 only, paired with `--demoted_psi_weight`. Full suppression (weight 0) cost more signal than the poison it blocked: MCC 0.825 -> 0.361.

identity_binding.why: Fix 1. Rejects beacon writes when the transmitter does not own the claimed ID. Measured -0.124 MCC with 40% of rejections falling on honest vehicles. Superseded by `--per_rsu_vehicle_state`, which solves the same contamination geometrically.

pop_anomalous_writes.why: Drops the anomalous beacon from kinematic history. Starves the history and drives FPR to 0.535.

verbose_tx.why: Per-beacon [DSRC-TX]/[LL-SEL] stdout. Off because it bloats long runs -- the 300 s logs are already ~600 MB per arm without it.

stealthy_control_plane.value: true (DEFAULT — never passed on the command line)
stealthy_control_plane.why: Active in every reported run by default. TP-S3/MP-S4 inject small plausible controller falsification that the beacon detectors cannot see; only CP-DETECT catches them. Pass `=false` for the legacy LOUD variant. The paper must state which mode produced its results.

hmac_fail_closed.why: Changes HMAC failure from scoring to hard rejection.

sybil_gat_evasive.why: Scatters ghosts onto distinct spread-out RSU cells to evade density detection, instead of the clustered ring.
sybil_gat_evasive.when: Adversarial-robustness testing of ring_detect -- the geometry test assumes a co-located ring, so this is its natural stressor and has NOT been run against it.

enable_rule_signatures.why: AB1 -- removes the psi FUSION term. NOTE: sig_mask and psi still feed the GAT input even under AB1, because the GAT consumes 16 features including psi and all nine signature bits.

lambda_gat.why: AB3 -- rescales the GLOBAL lambda triple only, keeping the psi:ae ratio. JSON on disk untouched.

lambda_ae.why: AB4 -- rescales the GLOBAL lambda triple only, keeping the psi:gat ratio. Needed because k_hat is -1 on most decisions, so the per-attack sets never apply and the global lambda_ae=0.3071 alone caps the AE's vote below Phi_th.

trs_compromised_f.why: AB6 f/n sweep -- forces F of n ring members compromised.

enable_fhe.why: AB7 -- plaintext aggregates, TRS still signs.

ab7_ring_n.why: AB7 x-axis, TRS/FHE ring size n. Added but NOT yet built or smoke-tested.

fhe_ring_dim.why: AB7 -- FHE ring dimension N (32768 vs 65536).

rsu_malicious_fraction.why: AB8 f/n sweep, decoupled from attack_percentage.

rsu_trust_quorum.why: AB8 -- overrides q_i quorum; 2 is reachable at 30 s but weakens BFT.

t_window.why: AB8 -- overrides SC-Revoke's T_w witness window, which was otherwise hardcoded at 30 s regardless of simTime. That hardcoding is why the 300 s AB8 test showed nothing.

rsu_t_rev.why: AB8 -- T_rev consecutive low-trust epochs before permanent demotion.

rsu_trust_alpha.why: AB8 -- RSU trust EMA alpha. THIS is the actual client-demotion gate (tau < tau_min = 0.3); T_rev only gates the later revoke escalation.

demoted_psi_weight.why: AB8 option B -- multiplier on a demoted RSU's psi. 0.5 default; 0 (full silence) measured worse than leaving the poison in.

enable_ctrl_rotation.why: AB9 -- single fixed controller vs the trusted-controller set.

ctrl_compromise_onset.why: AB9 x-axis -- controller compromise onset as a fraction of simTime.

use_lkh_tree.why: AB11 -- LKH tree vs per-member unicast rekey.

enable_sc_trust.why: R3 config 5 -- skips vehicle SC-Trust evidence submission; vehicle trust never decays.

enable_sc_revoke.why: R3 config 5 -- skips vehicle SC-Revoke vote; vehicles are never revoked.

eps_max.why: AB4 / Experiment 4 -- stealth drift cap per beacon.

stealth_fraction.why: Experiment 1 secondary axis -- stealth vs abrupt proportion (gamma).

psi_th.why: Composite alert threshold. WARNING: dual role -- it is both the LW alert threshold (`06d_ai_inference.h:1102`) AND the fusion normaliser (`:908`). Sweeping it moves the full-mode decision boundary too. Code default 0.09; the paper's sweep table selects 0.05.

delta_th.why: TP-S5 drift threshold. Reads vehicle_state, so its calibration is affected by `--per_rsu_vehicle_state`.

drift_window_k.why: TP-S5 drift observation window, in beacons. Same per-RSU-state coupling as delta_th.

k_sybil.why: MP-S1 Sybil density factor. NOTE: ring_detect now also fires the MP-S1 bit, so this no longer sweeps a single mechanism.

s_max_kmh.why: TP-S1/MP-S4 DETECTION speed bound, decoupled from --maxspeed and the trace. Also forces a full-mode detection via the hard speed-bound override.

phi_max.why: GAT graph heading-divergence bound. Code constant PHI_MAX_GRAPH is pi/2; `tab:fullmode-selected` claims 45 degrees for urban.

ablation_ab.why: Selects the AB1-AB11 variant by name.

trs_classical.why: AB7 -- ECDSA-class baseline instead of ML-DSA-87, for the signing-latency comparison.

t_batch.why: Tier-3 batch commit interval, seconds. Constraint: T_batch << T_w.

n_commit.why: Tier-3 batch commit threshold, evidence entries.

sybil_registration_pct.why: ⚠️ 0 selects the ORIGINAL Sybil mode, where ghost IDs sit OUTSIDE the registered pool. The code's own comment (02_config_globals.h:155-163) says detection is then "trivial" and "metrics are flat at 1.0 regardless of attack_percentage", and recommends 30-50 for meaningful variation. MP-S1/MP-S2 results and the ring_detect ghost-recall figure were all obtained in this easy mode.

faithful_mitm.why: MP-S3 (attack 6) ran in the default MitM mode, not the faithful variant added in commit dad4bc6.

mitm_stealth.why: MP-S3 ran non-stealth. Paired with --faithful_mitm as the a6 MitM variants.

honest_mp_s1.why: MP-S1 ghost injection behaves adversarially, not honestly. Diagnostic control for isolating MP-S1's FP contribution.

uniform_speed_trace.why: Trace keeps its natural SUMO speed distribution. Set true for Experiment 2, where every vehicle must travel at exactly the target speed.

rsu_seed.why: 0 does NOT mean non-reproducible here: when --seed>0 the RSU compromise RNG is derived as run_seed*2654435761+12345 (06a_attack_models.h:558), so the compromised-RSU set is deterministic at --seed=1. It only falls back to the system clock if --seed is also unset. Pass --rsu_seed=N to pin the RSU set independently of the run seed.

N_Controllers.why: Size of the registered controller set C. Relevant to the Eq 3.69 controller-quorum work: the SC-Revoke floor refuses an exclusion that would empty C_trusted, and with 4 controllers all four were once excluded in epoch E7 before that floor existed.

data_transmission_frequency.why: Beacon rate in Hz — 10 Hz = the 100 ms interval T_b assumed throughout the paper. Changing it invalidates every per-beacon threshold and the N_b/detection-feasibility derivation.

link_lifetime_threshold.why: Routing link-lifetime cutoff, calibrated for the 270 m DSRC range. Affects the routing plane only, not detection.

architecture.why: Network architecture variant selector. 0 is the standard three-plane SDVN layout used for all reported results.

lambda.why: Routing/link parameter. NOT the fusion weights lambda_1..3 — those come from fusion_weights.json and are set via --lambda_gat/--lambda_ae. Name collision; do not confuse them.

experiment_number.why: Experiment selector for the Exp1-Exp5 harness; 0 = plain run, which is what the reported detection results use.

routing_algorithm.why: Routing protocol selector. Inert for detection runs — meaningful only when --routing_test=true.

qf.why: Queue/flow parameter for the routing plane. Inert for detection runs.

delta_hmac.why: H5 Delta_HMAC beacon freshness window, seconds. A beacon whose timestamp is staler than this is rejected by LW-DETECT before signature scoring.

delta_trs.why: H6 Delta_TRS freshness window for sigma_TRS verification (Eq 3.53). Inert while --skip_blockchain=true.

poison_theta.why: AB4 sweep: attack deviation scale theta in [0,1], default 0.5. Scales max_position_deviation / max_velocity_deviation in PoisonTrajectoryByType(). LOWER = stealthier, so the psi rules and the spatial GAT stop saturating and the LSTM-AE becomes the discriminating tier. Left at its default in the reported runs.

rsu_positions_csv_override.value: unset for the canonical run; only E3 (scalability sweep) sets it for N_Vehicles=300/400/500
rsu_positions_csv_override.why: Default RSU coverage file (rsu_positions_urban.csv) is a fixed 64-RSU grid (supervisor-mandated 2026-06-12). E3 sweeps N_RSUs up to 160, which the file does not cover; without this override the simulator silently falls back to a broken legacy hardcoded grid with zero DSRC coverage on the real urban map (12_main.h ~1088-1107). Points at a separate place_rsus.py-generated CSV (mobility/e3_scalability/rsu_positions_urban_n{96,128,160}.csv, 100% coverage) instead, without touching the shared default file used by every other experiment.

mobility_trace_csv_override.value: unset for the canonical run; only E3 (scalability sweep) sets it for N_Vehicles=300/400/500
mobility_trace_csv_override.why: Default mobility trace (mobility_urban_60.tcl) only has 200 vehicle trajectories. E3 sweeps N_Vehicles up to 500, which the trace does not cover; without this override nodes beyond 199 get no MobilityModel and the simulator aborts inside LteHelper::InstallUeDevice() (12_main.h ~584-600). Points at a separately generated trace (mobility/mobility_urban{300,400,500}_60.tcl, built via sumo/build_sumo_trace.sh with VEH_COUNT_OVERRIDE, same road network, KEEP_IN so vehicles never despawn) instead, without touching the shared default trace used by every other experiment. Also required bumping total_size 256->550 and MAX_NODES 320->600 (02_config_globals.h) since those are fixed compile-time array capacities sized for the old 200-vehicle ceiling.
